Your AI has never read your files.
Welcome to Agent School — lesson nine.
We know AI only knows its training data, plus whatever is in its context window.
So how does a company chatbot know your refund policy?
One: search your documents for the parts that match the question.
Two: paste those parts into the prompt.
Three: the model answers using them.
The AI doesn't memorize your files — it looks things up, right when you ask.
And it fights hallucination, because now the answer comes with a source you can check.
The hard part is the search.
Find the wrong page… get the wrong answer.
Remember: RAG means look it up first, then answer.
